meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Python library for working with geospatial vector data including shapefiles, GeoJSON, and GeoPackage files. Use when working with geographic data for spatial analysis, geometric operations, coordinate transformations, spatial joins, overlay operations, choropleth mapping, or any task involving reading/writing/analyzing vector geographic data. Supports PostGIS databases, interactive maps, and integration with matplotlib/folium/cartopy. Use for tasks like buffer analysis, spatial joins between datasets, dissolving boundaries, clipping data, calculating areas/distances, reprojecting coordinate systems, creating maps, or converting between spatial file formats.

copy.tagline: 处理地理空间矢量数据，进行空间分析与制图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要处理 shapefile、GeoJSON 等地理数据并做空间分析
copy.tagline_en: Process geospatial vector data for spatial analysis and mapping
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with shapefiles, GeoJSON, or other vector geographic data for spatial analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能使用 GeoPandas 库读取、处理和分析地理空间数据，如 Shapefile、GeoJSON 等，并进行空间连接、缓冲区分析、坐标转换、地图绘制等操作。
howto.when: 当你要求处理地理数据，例如读取地图文件、计算面积、进行空间分析或创建地图时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GeoPandas 读取这个 Shapefile 并显示前几行。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并展示数据摘要。

say.text: 计算这两个 GeoJSON 文件中每个多边形的面积。
say.note: Claude 会进行面积计算并返回结果。

say.text: 将点数据与多边形数据进行空间连接，找出每个点所属的区域。
say.note: Claude 会执行空间连接操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the GeoPandas library to read, process, and analyze geospatial vector data such as Shapefiles, GeoJSON, and GeoPackage files, performing spatial joins, buffer analysis, coordinate transformations, and map creation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to work with geographic data, such as reading map files, calculating areas, performing spatial analysis, or creating maps.

say_en.text: Read this Shapefile with GeoPandas and show the first few rows.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and display a summary.

say_en.text: Calculate the area of each polygon in these two GeoJSON files.
say_en.note: Claude will compute areas and return results.

say_en.text: Spatially join the point data with the polygon data to find which region each point belongs to.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a spatial join.
